title: A call blocked for want of a place
description: A lender's collections desk calls a borrower whose instalment is in arrears. The call is handed to a collector, and the desk's own pack gives the collector no place, so the look is blocked for want of a place. This case is that one look; the recorded sequence learn_across shows three mornings, each a record of its own, blocked the same way until the day's roster gives two places, and what the learn feature reads of the three records together.
